body.message:
I don’t have any issue with payment. Once I confirm the problem is fully fixed and there is no more leakage, I will pay. Money is not the issue — I just need to be sure it’s properly resolved.

Several times a technician said it was fixed, but the leak came back at night.

Please also fix the access card, parking, and bathroom issues. If everything is properly solved, I’m happy to rent your properties long-term.
